# GitHub Copilot

Read `AGENTS.md` and `Docs/superpowers/agent-rules.md`. Reply to the user in Korean. Copilot is the **Gatekeeper**: before each commit batch and each push, run the checks in section 4 of `Docs/superpowers/agent-rules.md` and report pass or a numbered list of blockers with file and command output. Do not write features and never push.
